articles.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
articles.description: Two SEC-registered funds open to ordinary investors marked Ripple stock 70% apart on Sept. 30, and the lower mark sits barely above what the other fund paid in 2018.

articles.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
articles.description: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

articles.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
articles.description: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

articles.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
articles.description: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

articles.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
articles.description: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

articles.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
articles.description: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.description: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

articles.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
articles.description: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.

articles.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 25, 2026

articles.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
articles.description: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

articles.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
articles.description: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

articles.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
articles.description: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

articles.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
articles.description: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets bounce from big early declines
articles.description: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% plunge to just a modest loss, with Michael Burry announcing he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.

articles.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
articles.description: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

articles.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
articles.description: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

articles.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
articles.description: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

articles.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
articles.description: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

articles.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
articles.description: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

articles.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
articles.description: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

articles.title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
articles.description: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
articles.description: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

articles.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
articles.description: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

articles.title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
articles.description: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.description: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.
